description.en: Audio format. Only **wav**, **mp3**, and **amr** formats are supported.

description.zh:
组合播报内容，包括以下类型：

- 播报已成功推送至设备中的语料，填入语料的标识。

- 播报支持的动态内容，根据设备支持的具体规则传入。
    
    示例：金额，格式为`{$xxx}`，xxx为具体的金额数，如`{$1000}`，则设备播报**1000元**。
    
设备根据下发的CombinationList进行顺序播报。
description.en:
The list of combined broadcast content, which includes the following types:

- To broadcast corpus that has Succeeded in being pushed to the device, enter the identity of the corpus.

- To broadcast supported dynamic content, pass values according to the specific rules supported by the device.

    Sample: For an Amount, use the format `{$xxx}`, where xxx is the specific amount value. For example, `{$1000}` results in the device broadcasting **1000 yuan**.

The device broadcasts the items in the CombinationList sequentially.

description.zh:
设备的**DeviceName**。
如果传入该参数，需同时传入**ProductKey**。
description.en:
The **DeviceName** of the device.  
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.

description.zh:
是否下发强制播报标识给播报设备。

- false（默认）：不下发
- true：下发
description.en:
Whether to push the forced broadcast flag to the playback device.

- false (default): Do not push.
- true: Push.

description.zh:
设备ID，该参数可以通过调用[QuerySpeechDevice](~~280408~~)获取。

>如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。**IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**组合，则以**IotId**为准。
description.en:
Device ID. You can obtain this parameter by invoking [QuerySpeechDevice](~~280408~~).

> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. **IotId** is the Unique Identifier of a device and has a one-to-one mapping with the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify both **IotId** and the **ProductKey**-**DeviceName** combination, **IotId** takes precedence.

description.zh:
实例ID。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。</ph></props>

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

<props="china">实例的更多信息，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。</props>
description.en:
Instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can View the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** Page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

><notice>
- If an ID exists, you must specify it; otherwise, the invocation will fail.
- If no ID exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

description.zh: 设备所属的产品**ProductKey**。如果传入该参数，需同时传入**DeviceName**。
description.en: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs. If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.

description.zh:
下发给设备的唯一播报ID。
><notice>
若不传入则由系统生成，若业务上进行重试播报，需传入重试的播报ID，避免出现重复业务播报。
></notice>
description.en:
The unique speech ID assigned to the device.  
><notice>  
If this parameter is not provided, the system generates a Unique ID. If your service retries the speech playback, you must pass in the same speech ID used in the previous attempt to avoid duplicate business announcements.  
></notice>

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为20。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## queries per second (QPS) limit  
The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account calling this API is 20.  
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot sync-speech-by-combination --iot-id Q7uOhVRdZRRlDnTLv000000100 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name test --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --audio-format wav --speech-id 4200001139202111238000000000 --enforce-flag false --combination-list ZFBDZ --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot SyncSpeechByCombination --region cn-hangzhou --IotId Q7uOhVRdZRRlDnTLv000000100 --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --CombinationList.1 ZFBDZ --AudioFormat wav --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000 --EnforceFlag false --DeviceName test --SpeechId 4200001139202111238000000000
